task_instance: Fine-tune an object detection model (e.g. ustc-community/dfine-small-coco on the cppe-5 dataset) or an image classifier via Hugging Face Jobs, with the trained model pushed to the Hugging Face Hub, following the skill's Quick Start workflow.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires two things this runtime cannot provide: (1) a Hugging Face account with a paid Pro/Team/Enterprise plan plus a write-scoped HF_TOKEN to submit jobs via `hf_jobs`/`HfApi().run_uv_job()` on HF Jobs cloud GPUs and to push results with `push_to_hub=True` (a 'MUST' per the skill); (2) network access to huggingface.co, which this sandbox's egress proxy explicitly denies (confirmed 403 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial)' via direct curl to https://huggingface.co and via the Python huggingface_hub client, and huggingface.co is absent from the proxy's noProxy allowlist which only covers npm/pypi/anthropic/github endpoints). This blocks not only the cloud-GPU path but also the 'local' fallback path, since local training still needs to download pretrained checkpoints (D-FINE/RT-DETR/timm models) from the Hub and push trained weights back to it. No credential search or workaround was attempted per safety rules.

Checked `curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status` -> noProxy allowlist lists only api.anthropic.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, github (via gh CLI), etc. -- huggingface.co is not included, and recentRelayFailures show repeated connect_rejected/403 policy denials for other non-allowlisted hosts, confirming this is a deliberate egress policy rather than a transient failure. No HF_TOKEN or account credentials were present or searched for, per safety rules. Concluded the task cannot proceed past the network/account gate for either the HF Jobs cloud path or the local-training-with-Hub-persistence path.
